annotations.title: Feed diagnostics of a compared shop

description: The report of a compared shop's last feed read (P04): health ok | warn | fail, counts (items, with EAN, price, picture, availability, shipping, category), and coded issues (no_items, items_skipped, feed_unreadable, price_zero, currency_mismatch, url_not_shop_host, duplicate_item_id, encoding_suspect, price_outlier, missing_ean, availability_unknown, shipping_missing, image_missing, category_missing, stale_feed) each with a count, a share and the first five affected items by the shop's own item id and name. Public: no feed address, no item links (the partner's signed-in view at GET /api/v1/partner/feed-diagnostics carries the item links). `error.code` not_found when the shop is unknown or has no feed run yet. For a feed that is not compared yet use check_shop_feed.

slug.description: The shop's slug from list_shops or GET /api/v1/deals/shops.
